admin.system.roadmap.flow.launch_desc: The site opens and residents are notified.
admin.system.roadmap.flow.ready_desc: The appointments site works end to end, on the project's server.
admin.system.roadmap.flow.step1_desc: HSI connection, the official address and the launch date.
admin.system.roadmap.flow.step1_desc_no_: The official address and the launch date.
admin.system.roadmap.flow.step2_desc: The hospital's official WhatsApp number and opening the site.
admin.system.roadmap.flow.step3_desc: User accounts and a short training for staff.
admin.system.roadmap.progress.copy: 8 of 15 launch conditions are already complete
admin.system.roadmap.progress.copy_no_em: 7 of 14 launch conditions are already complete
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done1: Residents see the 134 services from the 10 health centers, with real schedules
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done10: All of this already works on the project's server
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done2: The appointment is booked from a phone; the medical referral is uploaded as a photo and the system reads it on its own
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done3: Accounts work by national ID; parents book appointments for their children
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done4: Staff approve or reject each request from this panel, with standard reasons
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done5: The connection to the medical record system (HSI) is built and tested locally
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done6: Patients get email notices: request received, appointment confirmed and a reminder the day before
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done7: If a closer slot opens up, it's offered to whoever is waiting
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done8: The web help chat and the WhatsApp integration are built and tested
admin.system.roadmap.simple.done9: Reports for management: demand, attendance hours and avoidable rejections
admin.system.roadmap.simple.later1_body: The patient requests the appointment and the consult happens over video. Useful for bringing in specialists who don't live in Pinamar: the region has already had specialist shifts canceled for lack of professionals, and the Province is pushing telemedicine.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.later2_body: Before seeing the patient, the doctor sees an automatic summary of their appointments and history, so they don't start from scratch every time.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.later_sub: Ideas for after launch, not being built yet.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.launch_body: With the three steps done, the temporary password comes off, residents are notified, and we track day-to-day use from this panel's reports.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step1_sub: We can't do this part alone: each piece needs the Municipality's cooperation.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step1c1_body: Approved appointments need to land in the real medical record. Missing the account and access to the hospital's HSI; the system already does it in testing.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step1c2_body: turnos.pinamar.gob.ar is enabled by the Municipality. The site currently lives at a temporary address.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step1c3_body: The official account to query the national health-coverage registry. Meanwhile it works with the public lookup.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step1c4_body: The presentation already happened. When to launch and how to tell residents gets decided later, with no rush.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step2c1_body: The system verifies identity over WhatsApp: a code when creating an account and to recover a password. It currently runs on a test number.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step2c2_body: With the official number, chat and verification start working for residents.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step2c3_body: It's currently behind a temporary password so nobody gets in early. Taking it off takes minutes.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step3c1_body: Rosa Vazquez, Rosa Rivero and Natalia Cobas already have their role defined. Missing their accounts and a short training.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step3c2_body: Each professional can see their own schedule and appointments. Rolled out gradually; doesn't block the launch.
admin.system.roadmap.simple.step3c3_body: Services, schedules and time off are edited from this panel; no longer dependent on a spreadsheet.
admin.system.roadmap.subtitle: The next steps to get the system running in Pinamar.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built1: 4 care modes, 134 services, 10 centers, 99 professionals (official Secretaria spreadsheet imported)
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built10: Automatic deploy on every push, running on the project's server; site behind a password ahead of launch
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built2: Wizard with AI referral reading (Gemini Flash), appointment soft-lock, waitlist and cancellations
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built3: National-ID accounts, coverage via PUCO/SISA, sign-up with a photo of the ID (barcode + OCR)
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built4: Review queue with suggestions, batch resolution and standard reasons
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built5: Admin / operator / doctor roles, per-doctor schedule and ICS feeds
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built6: Push to HSI + conflict resolver + automatic resync
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built7: 4 patient emails (Mailgun) + reminder the day before
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built8: Chat: one engine, three doors - web widget, WhatsApp (Meta + WAHA) and MCP - with web-to-WhatsApp handoff
admin.system.roadmap.tec.built9: Narrative reports, AI costs and a Sistema page with each integration's status
admin.system.roadmap.tec.later1_body: A modality flag on the service/schedule (in-person vs. video); approving the request generates the video-call link and sends it by email/WhatsApp, also visible on the doctor's schedule. Legal basis: telehealth law 27.678. Design in docs/roadmap/teleconsulta.md.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.later2_body: Automatic paragraph for the doctor before the visit, built from our own data (appointments, referrals read) - v1 doesn't touch HSI clinical data. Paper-record OCR already has its own research: docs/medical-history-ocr-findings.md. v1 design in docs/roadmap/resumen-historia-clinica.md.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.later2_body_no_: Automatic paragraph for the doctor before the visit, built only from our own data (appointments and referrals read). Paper-record OCR already has its own research: docs/medical-history-ocr-findings.md. v1 design in docs/roadmap/resumen-historia-clinica.md.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.later_sub: Not part of the launch. Design sketches in docs/roadmap/.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1_sub: The critical path: these pieces belong to the Municipality (reference-deployment counterpart / the Secretaria) and get built together with them; the code paths already exist and degrade gracefully.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1c1_body: Production runs with TURNOS_SKIP_HSI=1: missing the institutional endpoint and credentials for approvals to reach the real medical record. Client, resolver and resync are already tested against the local HSI.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1c2_body: turnos.pinamar.gob.ar needs the municipal DNS delegation. The Sistema page already flags the current host as provisional. Turnstile gets re-tied to the final domain.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1c3_body: The credential-free public lookup already works in production, so this adds robustness, it doesn't unblock anything.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1c4_body: Presentation done (week of 7/13) and the scheduling staff already named (meeting on 7/17). Missing the launch date and who announces it.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step1c4_title: Formal green light from the Secretaria
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step2_title: Step 2 - identity and messaging, on our side
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step2c1_body: A code at sign-up and to recover a password - the system is designed around WhatsApp. Missing the Meta-approved authentication template, business verification and the real number; the rest is already being built against the test number.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step2c2_body: The current Cloud API token expired and the number is Meta's test number. With a permanent token and the hospital's number, the WhatsApp door stays live.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step2c3_body: The old Spanish variable names are still configured on the server; the code reads both. Migrate once, then remove the fallbacks.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step2c4_body: A configuration change. Webhooks, MCP and export are already exempt, so nothing else moves.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step3c1_body: Rosa Vazquez, Rosa Rivero and Natalia Cobas get their operator login (the role has shipped since 7/17). A 1-page guide + a hands-on session: queue, schedules and time off.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step3c2_body: Each professional can have their own account with their own schedule + ICS feed. Rolled out gradually; doesn't block the launch.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.step3c3_body: The imported spreadsheet was the starting point; from launch on, the panel is the source of truth and the Secretaria owns adding/removing professionals.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week1_bold: One bundled ask to the technical counterpart
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week1_rest: endpoint + credentials for production HSI, the SISA WS131 status, and the DNS request for turnos.pinamar.gob.ar. All three are his, one message.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week1_rest_no_e: the SISA WS131 status and the DNS request for turnos.pinamar.gob.ar. Both are his, one message.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week2_rest: sending and validating the code are already being built against the test number; only the template approval is waiting on Meta.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week3_bold: The project team pastes in a permanent Meta token
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week3_rest: and decides real number vs. WAHA for launch volume.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week4_rest: to train staff the same day accounts are handed out.
admin.system.roadmap.tec.week_title: How to move forward this week
